name: human-review
description: Edit and comment on any live preview, or a task's HTML or Markdown page, directly in Human Review, and send your changes back to the task's worker. Can be your review surface in place of Lavish and the preview helper.

version.title: Human Review version
version.description: The human-review npm version the plugin installs and runs, such as 0.8.2. Workers take feedback with the same version.
